observed_facts: TSMC and ASML jointly announced an industry collaboration on 2026-09-07 to transition High-NA EUV photomasks from 6-inch to 12-inch formats; TSMC press release published 2026-09-08.
Target: 12-inch photomask pilot line by 2031; target: ecosystem readiness for advanced-node mass production by 2033. Both are future targets, not completed milestones.
TSMC stated an intention to adopt ASML High-NA EUV technology in advanced-node mass production beginning in 2030; not evidence that deployment is complete.
No incremental order value, committed revenue, or achieved manufacturing capacity disclosed.
publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) and ASML
